o1.biggest_strength: Builds pincode-differentiated COD confirm/hold logic and an after-hours bot around the exact RTO and chat-load signals, with a usable 48-hour hold and weekly scorecard.
o1.biggest_mistake: The prepaid-switch template is labeled Utility but pushes UPI payment and 'same exchange rules' — that can read as an offer/promotion and should likely be Marketing or split; plus a few placeholders (exchange wording) need filling.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Tighten the template categories (clean Utility vs Marketing split for the prepaid nudge) and remove all placeholder wording so it can be pasted and submitted today.

o2.biggest_mistake: It has only 9 templates and skips a dedicated delivery-day reattempt/'not home' handling and an explicit after-hours button menu, so the flow is thinner; also the prepaid '₹30 off' template risk and some sample variables feel less ready to paste.

reason: Both are strong; Output 1 is more complete — full template set, pincode-tiered hold logic, after-hours bot and scorecard — so an owner can run it tomorrow with less filling in. Output 2's ₹30 payback logic is excellent but the pack is thinner and needs more rework.
